forecast_scope_review.instruction: Re-estimate or explicitly reconfirm the whole-ticket estimates with a scoped rationale for the concrete A/D first wave and unresolved B/C remainder. Do not allocate quantiles proportionally, drop remaining work, or treat this as an A/D-only forecast.

stop_conditions: Bootstrap design decision, actual assignment/capacity, exact scope approval, forecast decision or scoped key authority remains missing.
Trusted private packet cannot be reproduced, authenticated, bounded or freshly verified before editing.
Source, scope, prerequisite, forecast, policy or trust binding changes or expires.
An edit is outside these exact paths or the assigned checkout; stop and obtain a concrete scope amendment.
A new writer changes legacy schema bytes, default semantics, minimum-reader policy, security/privacy limits or released compatibility mappings.
Conclusion-bearing semantics are missing or contradict an accepted design; report the smallest counterexample to the designated decision owner.
Installed-wheel evidence uses the checkout, a stale reader identity, network fetch, unverified wheel or misleading source fallback.
Resource budget or validation fails; retain exact diagnostics and do not truncate, weaken a check or silently expand the budget.
A/D implementation acceptance is absent: no dependent TEMP-01A or other first-writer work may start.
Current fixture regeneration changes anything beyond reviewed producer/evaluator version metadata and its derived hashes; stop rather than accepting a changed oracle conclusion.
